def loadGame():
    global session, gui, fife

    # Implementing load dialog
    load_dialog = fife.pychan.loadXML('content/gui/load_dialog.xml')
    load_dialog.x += int((settings.fife.screen.width - load_dialog.width) / 2)
    load_dialog.y += int((settings.fife.screen.height - load_dialog.height) / 2)
    load_dialog.show()
    fife.engine.pump()

    session.end()
    session = None

    if gui is not None:
        gui.hide()
    gui = fife.pychan.loadXML('content/gui/loadingscreen.xml')
    gui.x += int((settings.fife.screen.width - gui.width) / 2)
    gui.y += int((settings.fife.screen.height - gui.height) / 2)
    gui.show()
    fife.engine.pump()

    session = Session()
    session.begin()
    session.load()
    returnGame()
